title: Storyboard Flow: ask for a storyboard, get a stack of editable panels that feed Keyframes to Video
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1134 - Story and Infinite Video. Plan: tasks/MPI-1134/plan.md. Joined 2026-10-21 (Fabio). Idea. The user (or Cosmo) asks for a storyboard of a scene and gets a numbered set of panel pictures, consistent cast, the video's aspect ratio. Output is a STACK of panels the user edits one by one, not one sheet (Fabio: shape not settled). Plus ONE tiled 4K/8K overview image with each tile numbered top-left, so the user can ask Cosmo to edit tile N (Fabio 2026-10-21; reuses the sheet maker). Panels are the first step of long-form video: they feed the Keyframes to Video Flow (MPI-1191) as its keys, or seed Story shots. Cosmo calls the Flow instead of planning every frame itself. Brief: tasks/MPI-1231/brief.md.
